name: Sao Beach
summary: Southeast beach: swim the calm shallows for a half day, and come early on a weekday. The road from Dương Đông is about 25 minutes, and also about 25 km, along a shore of over 7 km. The sand is cát vàng óng, powder-white, and white. Entrance and parking are free. The sunset beach is Long Beach.
getThere: About 25 minutes by road from Dương Đông
bestMonths: November–April, and lunar month 11 to lunar month 4
heroCaption: Pale sand, shallow water, and the forested hill at Bãi Sao

notice.title: The sunset is on Long Beach
notice.body: Bãi Sao is the southeast swim, and the sunrise is here. Schedule the Gulf sunset on Bãi Trường.

body: Swim and walk Bãi Sao, and come early on a weekday if you want the shore quiet. The sand is cát vàng óng, fine like a carpet. The sea is calm and clear, with green shade trees, Robinson huts, and hammocks. The sand is also powder-white and white, with coconut palms, green hills, and the island’s sunrise. The shore runs over 7 km. Entrance and parking are free.

The beach is about 25 minutes by road from the centre of Dương Đông, and also about 25 km from the centre, near An Thới. A boat goes 15–30 km offshore for squid. Look for cùi biên mai nướng and rượu sim rừng. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing run here. Give the beach a half day from the west coast, or the full day if you stay for the swim and the shade.

figures.caption: A fishing boat in the shallows, with the hill behind Bãi Sao
figures.alt: A turquoise fishing boat in clear shallow water at Sao Beach, Phu Quoc

gettingThere: Bãi Sao is about 25 minutes by road from the centre of Dương Đông, and about 25 km from the centre, near An Thới. Entrance and parking are free. A taxi, a minibus, or a motorbike is the ride.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: About 25 minutes by road from the centre of town, or about 25 km. Come early on a weekday.

legs.heading: From Long Beach
legs.body: A half day from the west coast. The sunrise is here. The boat for squid goes 15–30 km offshore.

admissionNote: Entrance and parking are free. Jet skis, a water park, and parasailing run here. Ask on the beach for those prices.
